jobs.description: Fairtrade is the most recognized and trusted sustainability label, working to make trade fairer for people and planet.For more than three decades, Fairtrade has been making an impact on the way trade works. We believe that every farmer and worker should have access to a better way of doing business, and a better way of living. Fairtrade International is an independent non-profit organisation representing more than two million small-scale farmers and workers worldwide. It owns the FAIRTRADE Mark, a registered trademark that appears on more than 37,000 products. Beyond certification, Fairtrade International and its member organisations (three producer networks and 19 national Fairtrade organisations) partner with producers and businesses, engage consumers, and advocate for a fair and sustainable future.Unit’s description and purpose: The International Partnerships and Programmes Implementation Unit leads and coordinates system-wide resource mobilisation and partnership development to enable the delivery of Fairtrade’s strategic priorities. It also ensures the effective management of externally funded projects led by Fairtrade International. Our purpose is to secure new financial resources and partnerships that empower Fairtrade and its members to improve the lives of farmers and workers and contribute to the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals through quality programmes and projects.  A grant has been secured funded by the European Commission’s LIFE programme for a three year project (June 2025-May 2028) to be implemented in partnership with 5 national Fairtrade organisations in Europe. The aim of the project is to strengthen the capacity of companies, particularly 1000 MSMEs in 12 EU Member States, to comply with the EU Deforestation Regulation (EUDR). The Unit requires the Project Officer to coordinate the project that includes project staff allocated in five national Fairtrade organisations.PRINCIPAL ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:The Project Officer (70% FTE) will play a key role in the project’s coordination, financial and administrative management, and compliance with European Commission requirements. The post holder will take the lead in meeting reporting obligations towards the EC, engaging with stakeholders, and supporting the project's implementation. Specifically, the Project Officer will:- Ensure effective implementation  of the project, organising on-line operational  meetings with partners, documenting agendas and key decisions.- Ensure coordination among all project partners resulting in effective project implementation, including the planning and  delivery of annual in-person project meetings with partners.- Compile a final internal and donor narrative report on project progress and challenges and liaise with donor on requested changes to the project.- Maintain project financial documentation and process financial expenditure (in coordination with the Finance team).- Ensure compliance with and visibility of donor requirements.- Contribute to the implementation of the project’s data management protocols, and monitoring and evaluation plan (in close collaboration with MEL experts).- Act as the primary contact for the European Commission and the Consortium Steering Committee, providing progress updates and reports.- Manage and maintain the project’s risks, assessing their impact, and implementing mitigation strategies in collaboration with project partners and the Consortium Steering Committee to ensure project objectives are met.- Actively engage with other related projects, creating synergies and leveraging complementary efforts. This will involve networking, coordinating joint activities, and sharing knowledge and resources to enhance overall project outcomes.Additional project management tasks, and contribution to the IPPI team’s workplans will be expected that are consistent with the level and responsibilities of this post.SKILLS REQUIRED:Level of education: The position holder will have a bachelor’s degree in development, business, international relations or comparable qualifications or another relevant field. Years of professional experience: A minimum of 2 years’ experience in project management. Basic knowledge of EUDR (desirable).Job Specific Competencies/knowledge:- Grant-management- Grant-financial management- Project Planning and Implementation- Project Monitoring and Controlling- Stakeholder Management- Donor relations- Project ClosurePersonal Qualities:- Relationship Management- Coordination- Reporting- Organization- Independent Work- Problem-Solving- Attention to Detail- DiplomacySoftware/Tools: Project Management Software (e.g. NextCloud, others), MS365 ( Excel, Word, Outlook, Power Point, Teams, Planner, Forms, Canva, Clipchamp, Kobo toolbox),  Claude and other relevant AI digital toolsTERMS AND CONDITIONS:- This is a fixed-term position from 1st of February 2027 until the project end date of 31 May 2028 within Fairtrade International.- Location is at Fairtrade International offices in Bonn, Germany with the opportunity for hybrid work arrangements- The office language is English.- Salary as per the Collective Bargaining Agreement for the Wholesale and Foreign Trade Industries for North Rhine Westphalia Group V and over tariff payment.- Holiday Bonus and 13th salary  - 30 days of holidays per year (for fulltime employees)- Subsidised public transportation ticket- Subsidised meal services- Childcare cost subsidy Please note that Fairtrade International is strict on compliance with the required qualification criteria mentioned above, and only those candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.Disclaimer: the position is contingent upon the successful signing of the project’s contract with the donor.We will review applications as they come in, so we encourage interested candidates to apply at their earliest convenience. The German Diabetes Center (DDZ), Leibniz Institute for Diabetes Research at the Heinrich Heine University (HHU) Düsseldorf is an interdisciplinary research institute that links basic and clinical sciences to improve prevention, diagnosis and therapy of Diabetes mellitus and its complications. The Junior Research Group Crosstalk (head: Dr. Melanie Mittenbühler) at the Institute for Clinical Biochemistry and Pathobiochemistry focuses on how inter-tissue communication impacts energy balance and metabolic health. We are seeking a talented and highly motivatedPostdoctoral Fellow (PhD/Dr. rer. nat., m/f/div., E13 TV-L 100%) to join our research group. Our group investigates how skeletal muscle acts as an endocrine organ and communicates with other tissues through secreted signaling molecules, particularly myokines. In the ERC Starting Grant project MYOSCAN, we systematically investigate how exercise and age-related muscle loss alter the skeletal muscle secretome. We aim to identify novel exercise-sensitive myokines and define their roles in sarcopenia, metabolic disease, and cancer biology. A central question is whether muscle-derived factors promote or suppress tumor growth and how these signaling pathways can be therapeutically targeted.PhD in molecular biology, cell biology, biochemistry, physiology, exercise science, metabolism, cancer biology, or a related fieldStrong expertise in at least one of the following areas: proteomics/mass spectrometry, secretome analysis, cell biology, molecular signaling, metabolic research, or cancer biology. Experience in working with mouse models is preferredScientific curiosity, initiative, strong analytical skills, and the ability to work both independently and collaborativelyExcellent written and spoken English skillsExperience in supervising students or doctoral researchersWe provide a fully funded postdoctoral position within an excellently supported ERC Starting Grant project, an exciting, dynamic and international working environment, and a structured and coherent mentoring and training program. You will be able to learn state-of-the-art methodologies in a team of young scientists. Initially, the position is to be awarded for 2 years starting from 01.03.2027 or later. An extension of the contract period is envisaged. The employment contract is governed by TV-L in its current version for North Rhine-Westphalia, including the special regulations regarding the scientific area. The salary is based on qualification and experience, according to TV-L.Females are especially encouraged to apply, and in the case of equal qualification, handicapped persons will be given preference. The German Diabetes Center is committed to family-friendly working conditions and equal gender policy. Since May 2011, the DDZ is a “Career and Family” audit-acknowledged center. The provisions of § 7 no. 1 of the Act on Part-Time Work and Fixed-Term Employment are taken into account.

jobs.description: OUR COMPANYAt Boehringer Ingelheim we develop breakthrough therapies and innovative healthcare solutions in areas of unmet medical need for both humans and animals. We believe that, if we have talented and ambitious people who are passionate about innovation, there is no limit to what we can achieve; after all, we started with just 28 people. Now, we are powered by 50,000 employees globally who nurture a diverse, collaborative and inclusive culture.The PositionAre you passionate about innovation, finding cutting-edge solutions and creating value where it matters, around the globe? We foster innovative thinking as well as an agile and collaborative way of working to advance our novel programs and capabilities in Therapeutic Area Inflammation.The Global TA Inflammation, (Senior) HEOR  Manager, brings technical expertise, driving Outcomes Research (HEOR) and Patient Related Outcomes fostering our patient centric drive. His/she will support the TA Market Access Head by providing oversight, direction, and functional support on HEOR & PRO & Access projects. He/she will be working closely with Value and Evidence Networks within our Global Business Unit and with external stakeholders.Tasks & responsibilities- In your new role, you develop and execute on health economics outcomes research (HEOR) & PRO strategies, demonstrating the medical and economic payer-relevant needs to optimize value of BI products.- In this function, you generate evidence that development of the Target Product Profile (TPP), clinical development plan of our pipeline compounds.- In consideration of regulatory body request and trial development, pre and post launch you will ensure relevant and new patient-reported outcome (PRO) measurement strategies to ensure that the patient perspective is captured in our clinical trial program and interact with regulatory authorities, closely collaborating with other functions.- Besides, you ensure efficient and timely development of key HEOR deliverables (i.e. payer value stories, payer engagement tools, GVDs, economic models, retrospective database analyses, indirect comparisons, real world evidence data) for assigned BI products.- Finally, yet importantly, you develop and maintain relevant partnerships with payers, academic research institutions, contract research organizations and other HEOR thought leaders in order to optimize the impact of HEOR & PRO research.Additional responsibilities as Senior Manager:- You will define long-term global development strategies for the assets, in close collaboration with the global Marketing and global Medical counterparts, to ensure optimal patient access.- In addition, you will draft long-term publication strategies, considering the long-term global market development.Requirements- Graduate degree, preferably PhD in health economics, Medicine (MD), public health, pharmacy, focusing on Health Technology Assessment, PRO, Pharmacy, Medicine, Public Health- Several years of pharma industry experience, with positions in areas of relevance for HEOR, PRO consulting or payer authorities- Multiple years of direct experience undertaking Health Technology Assessments (HTA) & PRO including Evaluations for Regulatory and health authority interventions of pharmaceutical products- Conducting or being part of a team working on non-interventional studies and RWE programs- Demonstrated experience of successful regulatory, reimbursement negotiations for launching new products in key markets- Proven track record of delivering value demonstration materials that resulted in timely patient access and adoption- Proven ability in appraising clinical evidence (both RCTs and operational evidence)- Profound knowledge and expertise to formulating COA strategies including validation methods, administration of measures and statistical analyses of COA data- Excellent communication and influencing skill both in internal and external contextAdditional requirements as Senior HEOR Manager:- Long-term pharma industry experience, with positions in the areas of health economics, pricing & reimbursement, consulting, or payer authorities- Several years of exposure to international business on a day-to-day basis- Strong track record in value generation, demonstration and/or communication- Highly experienced in conducting health economics/outcomes research across multiple specialty disciplines (e.g. patient reported outcomes, health economic modelling, real world data generation)For employees with a current contract of limited duration, legal / labor agreement requirements for contract extension will be considered.With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.Want to learn more? jobs.description: CompanyOperating on a global scale through an international sales and distribution network, tk accelis Trading, formerly thyssenkrupp Materials Trading, is your partner for long-term success. With our local contacts around the world we are represented where the customers need us. Our core capabilities embrace complex logistic services for raw and finished steel materials along with supply chain dependability and consultancy for the downstream manufacturing and metalworking industries.Your responsibilitiesBuild and scale profitable physical steel trading flows, with particular emphasis on cross-border and third-country trading. Sales market focus is EMEA. We are open to candidates trading steel products, including flat products, long products, semi-finished products, or finished goods (steel derivates).
